summary_en: The study tests CTX112, a donor-derived (allogeneic) T-cell therapy that uses CRISPR-Cas9 gene editing to target CD19, in adults with relapsed or refractory B-cell malignancies such as lymphomas and chronic lymphocytic leukemia/small lymphocytic lymphoma. CTX112 is given by IV infusion after lymphodepleting chemotherapy; how long or how often is not stated. The main outcome is not stated; this is a Phase 1/2 study of safety and efficacy.
summary_es: El estudio evalúa CTX112, una terapia con células T de donante (alogénicas) editadas con CRISPR-Cas9 para atacar CD19, en adultos con neoplasias de células B recidivantes o refractarias, como linfomas y leucemia/linfoma linfocítico de células pequeñas. CTX112 se administra por infusión intravenosa después de quimioterapia de linfodepleción; la duración o la frecuencia no se indican. El resultado principal no se indica; es un estudio de Fase 1/2 de seguridad y eficacia.
who_for: Adequate kidney, liver, heart and lung function.
Agrees to use effective contraception from enrollment through at least 12 months after infusion.
not_for: Cancer involvement of the central nervous system, now or in the past.
